frame: glTF metres, Y up, body faces +Z; joints JSON is Blender (x, y, z) -> glTF (x, z, -y)

landmark_rules.face_midline: anatomy face_T_zone.midline_x_cm (the face is NOT on x = 0)
landmark_rules.hairline_y: brow + (brow - chin) / 2  (face thirds: hairline->brow = brow->nose base = nose base->chin)
landmark_rules.eye_band: anatomy eye_y_abs +- 1.5 cm, |x - midline| <= 5 cm, front half of the head — hair must leave it clear
landmark_rules.upper_garment_centre_y: chest joint + anatomy chest.peak_y_above_chest_joint_cm (bust / pec peak)

pose_note: lower garments in sit / crouch / kick / run are REPORTED, not gated: a skirt needs cloth bones or physics there (no fitter can make a rigid skirt follow a 90 deg thigh)

gates.standoff_note: median gap between the asset's INNER surface and the skin it covers; above it the asset reads oversize (Boss 25/10). Hair 12: spiky shells are thick at the roots; upper 8: a bandeau is tight
gates.face_clear: eye_L/eye_R/nose rays (3 each) must not hit hair; mouth/cheeks reported (a beard covers them by design)
gates.see_through_note: rays from the skin a garment must hide (waist → buttock fold, under-bust → top edge), outward: a miss = skin visible. Boss 25/10 «Quần lòi da ở mông»
gates.beard_note: Boss 25/10 «râu chưa sát vào mặt»: rays from jaw/cheeks/chin to the beard's inner surface
gates.hair_hanging_note: Boss 25/10 «đuôi tóc đang xoay bên trái mặt»: free-hanging hair (below the eyes, > 4 cm off the skin) must be behind the ears; beards hug the jaw and are not counted
gates.beard_thickness_note: p90 distance of beard verts (lower face, in front of the ears) from the skin — Boss 25/10 ×2 «râu chưa sát vào mặt»
gates.beard_holes_note: 2 mm ortho grid over the beard's own silhouette in 6 views (front, front-down -20, 3/4 L/R, sides): rays hitting skin/nothing before the beard. Boss 25/10 x2 «râu … lủng» — REPORT-ONLY (25/10): v6/v7/v8 all read 7-235 skin rays per oblique view from grazing strap edges; calibrate on the closed v9 beard (positive) vs v8 (known hole) before switching live

budget_note: lower = skirt 900 + belt 150 + ornament 60 (outfit spec); the old 900 decimated the agent's belt + ornament away; hair 1600 (25/10): Boss chose the denser v1 hair + 5 big spikes + the sealed v4 beard
face_note: kind 'face' = brows from eyebrow_fitter.py: placed on the skin, never moved by the fitter, pinned to the head bone; counted inside the hair budget
